text:
kai: Quick question: where do people prefer the copy/export actions in the trace detail? Inline next to the corr-id, in a compact header, or tucked into a kebab menu? Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz

riley: Inline for quick triage. Users often hunt for the corr-id and expect a copy affordance right next to it.

devon: Agree inline for single-trace views. For list/drilldown, prefer a truncated pill with a small inline copy icon to keep row height tight.

jess: A11y: if icon-only, provide aria-label and tooltip. Announce copy success with aria-live polite: "Correlation ID copied to clipboard." Ensure focus styles meet contrast and visible focus rules.

kai: Proposal: prototype two patterns: A) header layout (meta stacked, full actions) B) compact inline (meta left, actions right, kebab for secondary). Which to build first?

riley: Start with compact inline + kebab. Then add header variant if users need more context. Also add sticky bulk export CTA when multiple traces selected.

devon: Analytics to capture: trace.copy_id (props: trace_id, view:list|detail), trace.export (props: selected_count, trigger:sticky|kebab). Also track where users open kebab: row vs header.

jess: Keyboard flow: tab to corr-id -> copy button -> kebab. Kebab must use aria-haspopup and arrow key navigation. After an action, return focus to trigger.

kai: Microcopy decision: visible "Copy ID" vs "Copy correlation ID". jess: visible short label OK, aria-label should be full phrase. Toast text as above.

a11y-bot: Tickets created: D-3101 (Compact inline copy), D-3102 (Header actions), D-3103 (Sticky bulk export).

kai: Action items: kai update Figma with inline + header variants by Mon; riley prototype compact interactions by Tue; devon write analytics spec by Wed; jess add accessibility checklist + toast copy by Wed.

riley: I'll also test with 3rd-party screen readers and post notes.

kai: Thanks all 44D closing this thread, will reopen with prototypes."
